items.label: Opus drafts, 25 real people as filter
Opus drafts, 100 real people as filter

caption: Claude alone covers 61% of real people. With only 25 real people as the filter, Opus drafts reach 81% and statistics fitted on the same 25 reach 82%: a tie within noise (the seed ranges overlap), and Opus never beats statistics on average (with 100 people: 88% vs 89%). Opus's picks look more realistic (precision 0.96+ vs 0.87 for statistics); Haiku drafts, archetypes and recipes fall short. Bars show the range over seeds (or a 95% interval for single runs); scored on GSS test people none of the methods saw.
